02

“Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from the two…”

Two explanations transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 43:31).

873
Explanation from Sufyān No. 873: 3: 2

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
873: 3:2. Sufyan, from Imran al-Tai, from his maternal uncle, who said:
I heard Ibn Abbas say, on the words of God "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from the two cities?": He said, al-Taif and Mecca. He said, the great man of one of them is al-Mukhtar, they say Ibn Abi Ubayd, and the other is among the great men of Quraysh (verse 31).
العربية
873: 3: 2 سفيان عن عمران الطايفي عن خاله قال سمعت بن عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ لولا نزل هذا القرآن عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ قال الطايف وَمَكَّةَ قَالَ الْعَظِيمُ أَحَدُهُمَا النَّخْتَارُ يقول بْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ وَالْآخَرُ مِنْ عظماء قريش (الآية 31) .
Edition record 371509 · p. 270Link to report ↗
874
Report from Mujāhid No. 874: 4: 7

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
874: 4:7. Sufyan, from Mujahid:
"Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from the two cities?": He said, Utba ibn Rabia.
العربية
874: 4: 7 سفيان عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ لَوْلا نُزِّلَ هَذَا القرآن عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ قال عتبة بن ربيعة.
Edition record 371510 · p. 271Link to report ↗

04

“We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful…”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 43:33, 43:35).

876
Explanation from Sufyān No. 876: 6: 10

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
876: 6:10. Sufyan, on His words
"We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful roofs of silver for their houses": He said, beams; "and stairways on which they ascend": he said, steps ⦗p. 272⦘ "to ascend on" (verse 33); "and ornaments [zukhruf]": he said, gold (verse 35).
العربية
876: 6: 10 سفيان فِي قَوْلِهِ لَجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَالَ الْجُذُوعُ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ قال الدرج ⦗p. 272⦘ يظهرون (الآية 33) وزخرفا قال الذهب (الآية 35) .
Edition record 371510 371511 · pp. 271–272Link to report ↗
